t: This is We Watch You Too, a bench that is also an artwork, made by Pablo Reinoso. Reinoso is an Argentine-French artist and designer who has been working in Paris since 1978. So this is a piece of public seating made by someone who works across art and design, and the two ideas meet right here. It's worth a closer look at the shape of the bench itself, and then, if you like, sit down. The title is a hint to keep in mind while you do.
